p.s: Dear Mrs Smith
I am writing to reply your letter you wrote me on 10 June.
Firstly, I would like to tell you, that the group has been booked into Palace Hotel, which locates beside the congress house in the centre.
You can make contact with Mrs Brackenbury using the number 06 8793888.
Secondly, the best way from the hotel to the conference is to take the bus, which is specially organized by us.
The bus leaves at 8:00 every morning and gets back to the hotel at 6 o'clock in the evening.
Off course there's also a bus number 8 in front of the hotel is also suitable, but it leaves only every half an hour.
The end-of-conference party, which happens in the evening on 20 June, is going to be held on the coast.
Beside the barbecue, there are some well-known student bands from our country are performing music through the whole night.
What's more is, that there's a Latin music band coming to make the party more colourful.
It plays from 10:00 to 11:00, while the students can enjoy it with dancing.
The main events of the party will end up at about 12:30 in the night.
As you see, what to wear is just something casual.
Finally, in the last afternoon, we could visit the museums, markets (we have a very interesting robot-market).
Basically it's a free time for the students to look round here by themselves.
I hope your questions re answered appropriatly.
I'm looking forward to seeing you on the conference.
Yours sincerely,

p.s: Computer Life
Now-a-day computer can be found in almost every corner, in offices, in shops.
Or even in cars and washmachines there're computer chips.
What has computer affected to our life?
First of all, the efficiency of the society has been improved.
When shopping, we don't need to wait the Kasse to take every article's note by hand.
When booking a airline, we can just simply make a phone to any agency, and get it done in one minute.
Secondly, instead of looking up tons of books to get the information what we need, we can very easily search it from internet or on the local network.
It's a very often heard, that someone, who has a special illness, gets operations by a foreign institutes, which he find via internet.
Moreover, with computer network, it can be possible that people work from home, making projects, controling operations or having conferences.
Lastly the way of communications has been also changed.
Instead of the tranditional telecommunication, we can talk , mail or even see each other with the help of computer network.
Of course there're also some aspects in which the computer technology need to be improved.
For example, reading on the screen is still not as comfortable as on papers.
A very important and severe problem is the reliability and security.
Till now, to completely rely on computer is still somehow not safe enough.
In conclusion, computer have become a very essential necessity of our life, and it's still a young invention, which need to be improved.
